choice.basis: The chart 'Rest of the World vs U.S.' shows data points for 2020. The blue line (U.S.) ends at a high point on the y-axis, while the red dashed line (Rest of the world) ends at a very low point near the bottom of the chart. Visually, the 2020 value for the U.S. is significantly larger than the 2020 value for the Rest of the world.
